response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but a poor fit for this specific role. C++ experience is minimal and dated (a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project), far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital was retail investment fintech, not capital markets — and no SQL Server/Oracle exposure is evidenced. Strengths in TypeScript/Node, DLang, and DevOps do not offset the missing core requirements.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience with strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of requests/sec at Sociomantic using DLang)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and teaching
concerns: C++ experience is brief and over a decade old, versus the mandatory 5–10 years on Windows
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience (only MySQL/MongoDB listed)

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain expertise
Strong general engineering and CI/CD fundamentals
